# Maako Ravelle WOUROUGOU

> AI engineer from Burkina Faso, based in Fès, Morocco. Full-time PhD candidate in AI for cybersecurity at the Euro-Mediterranean University of Fès (UEMF), defense expected in December 2027. He builds speech and translation systems for languages with little data, AI agents, and intrusion detection models.

This file summarizes https://ravel226.github.io/, a portfolio in French and English. The full name used on publications is Maako Ravelle Cédric Roland Wourougou.

- Looking for: a paid six-month doctoral internship in 2027, in AI for cybersecurity or speech.
- Currently: available part-time, remote.
- Contact: ravellewourougou@gmail.com
- Languages: French, English, Spanish.

## Research

- [Data augmentation for intrusion detection](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7434328): under review at Array (Elsevier) since September 2026. A benchmark of 6 augmentation methods, from SMOTE to diffusion models, with 6 classifiers on 5 intrusion detection datasets, 10 random seeds and paired statistical tests.
- Transformer and attention-based models for network intrusion detection, a systematic literature review: submitted in October 2026 to the Journal of Internet Services and Applications (JISA), co-written with Taha Ait Tchakoucht. 71 studies from 2020 to 2025, kept from 333 records in six databases by two independent reviewers (PRISMA 2020).
- Does religious training data leak into translation?: in preparation, target journal ACM TALLIP. A controlled study on French to Mooré translation with NLLB-200.

## Projects

- Nylah (agent system, 2026, Python, private repository): a personal AI assistant that splits a hard goal into a task graph, runs workers in parallel waves, checks its own answer, and reports when something failed.
- Lecteur vocal (browser extension, 2026, JavaScript): a Chrome and Edge extension that reads web articles, PDFs and selected text aloud with neural voices that run offline, built for reading research papers in French and English.
- Fongbé speech and translation API (ByteInnovIT, 2024 to 2025): translation, speech recognition and speech synthesis for Fongbé, a language of Benin with very little digital text, served as one API.
- Strategic watch for agriculture (Les Domaines Agricoles, Casablanca, 2024): collects market, competitor and technology news every day, then classifies and summarizes it with GPT-4 into watch reports.
- CONSISTIA (document AI, 2025, Python): checks marketing documents against a brand charter with a local LLaMA 3.1 model.
- [PhantomProbe](https://github.com/Ravel226/PhantomProbe): passive-first reconnaissance for penetration testers, open source (MIT), published on PyPI.
- OpenStar (in progress, FastAPI, three.js): a self-hosted OSINT dashboard, with doxxing features deliberately left out.
- Animated invitations for SOFATO (client work, 2025): digital invitations for Société Faso Tomate and a Guinness World Record attempt.
- [Bubble-sheet grader](https://github.com/Ravel226/Bubble_Sheet_Corrector): grades a multiple-choice answer sheet from a phone photo with OpenCV.
- [Drowsiness detection](https://github.com/Ravel226/Drowsiness_Detection): flags driver drowsiness from a webcam in real time with a YOLOv5 model trained on a self-collected dataset.
